stem:
Omkar must construct a $90^\circ$ angle at point O on a given straight line.

Which plan is correct?

options.text: Keep O on the line, but skip making O the midpoint of a segment on that line.
First draw a line through O that looks upright, then mark equal distances from O.
Mark points X and Y on the line at equal distances from O so that O is the midpoint of XY, then construct the perpendicular bisector of XY.
Treat O as a point outside the line and drop a perpendicular from outside.

teacher.key_rationale: To raise a perpendicular at O on a line, first make O the midpoint of a segment XY on the line; the perpendicular bisector of XY is then perpendicular to the line at O.
